model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different language models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, with tick labels at intervals of 2⁰, 2¹, 2², 2³, 2⁴, 2⁵, 2⁶, 2⁷, and 2⁸. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A blue line with circular markers represents “Llama-3B”; this line begins at approximately (2⁰, 0.4) and increases to approximately (2⁸, 0.86). A green dashed line with triangular markers represents “Llama-3B + FT”, starting at approximately (2⁰, 0.4) and reaching approximately (2⁸, 0.83). A light green line with diamond markers represents “Llama-1B”, beginning at approximately (2⁰, 0.4) and increasing to approximately (2⁸, 0.74). Finally, a light blue dashed line with star markers represents “Llama-1B + FT”, starting at approximately (2⁰, 0.4) and reaching approximately (2⁸, 0.76).
